meta.title: Where We Go for Seafood in Da Nang, Vietnam
meta.description:
Da Nang is a coastal city, so seafood is naturally a big part of eating here.

In this episode, Ami and I head out for seafood in Da Nang and continue our long-running exploration of the restaurants, local favorites and food experiences that make this city such a great place to eat.

The Eating in Da Nang series isn't meant to be a definitive “best restaurants” list. It is simply where we actually go, what we order, what we enjoy and the places we discover while living here.

If you're visiting Da Nang, moving to Vietnam or simply curious about the city's food scene, the series offers an ongoing look at eating our way through Central Vietnam one meal at a time.

#danang #vietnamfood #seafood

Eating in Da Nang (Vol. 14) – Seafood Edition
